_about: Researched contents for sealed products that the parser gets wrong. Read by tools/ppt/sealed_contents.py. Key: TCGplayer product ID. The fields packs, mix, promos, other, and note replace the parsed fields. A field that is not here keeps its parsed value. Mix keys are set slugs, '<series> Series' for packs from an unnamed set in a named series, or 'unknown'. Every entry needs a sources list. The name field is only for the reader.

236378.name: V Strikers Tin [Empoleon V]
236378.note: North American hexagonal tin, first print run. The fifth pack is Vivid Voltage, Cosmic Eclipse, Celestial Storm, or Guardians Rising. Later shipments held 2 Fusion Strike, 2 Evolving Skies, and 1 Chilling Reign; from December 2022, 2 Brilliant Stars and 3 Evolving Skies, or 5 Brilliant Stars.

529698.name: Heavy Hitters Premium Collection (Fall 2023)
529698.other: Jumbo Lucario V (Astral Radiance 78), 4 Jumbo coins
529698.note: The September 2023 Sam's Club version of the Lucario V & Tyranitar V collection. The parser matched the 2025 Unova Heavy Hitters section. The TCGplayer image shows Lost Origin and Silver Tempest packs.

532539.name: Sinnoh Stars Mini Tins 5-Pack
532539.note: Costco, production code C22. Each tin typically holds one Brilliant Stars and one Astral Radiance pack, or one Lost Origin and one Fusion Strike pack. The TCGplayer description gives the count for one tin.

551456.name: Costco Galar Pals Mini Tins 5-Pack
551456.note: Costco, production code C22: each tin typically holds one Evolving Skies and one Brilliant Stars pack. The Amazon version (batch E23) holds two Fusion Strike packs in each tin.

509570.name: Paldea Legends Tins [Bundle of 2]
509570.note: The TCGplayer image shows two octagonal tins. An octagonal tin holds 4 packs: 2 Paldea Evolved, 1 Scarlet & Violet, 1 Silver Tempest. The single TCGplayer tin without 'International Version' (497390) is also octagonal.

543171.name: Paldea Legends Tins [Bundle of 2] (International Version)
543171.note: The TCGplayer image shows two hexagonal tins. A hexagonal tin holds 5 packs: 2 Paldea Evolved, 1 Scarlet & Violet, 1 Silver Tempest, 1 Brilliant Stars. The single TCGplayer 'International Version' tin (497387) is also hexagonal.

636312.name: Costco Pokemon Collector 3-Pack: Crown Zenith ETB + Paldea Legends Tins
636312.note: A Crown Zenith ETB (10 packs), a large Koraidon tin (2 Paldea Evolved, 3 Silver Tempest), and a small Miraidon tin (2 Paldea Evolved, 2 Silver Tempest). The TCGplayer description says 18 packs, the same text as the 151 bundle, but the Crown Zenith ETB holds one more pack than the 151 ETB.
